## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the legacy-header test because its fixture exits before header validation and never changes the header to v0. This review read both changed files and all repository tests; the separate complete-report test exercises unsupported-version rejection. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request requires the exact header `REPORT v1` and adds tests intended to reject legacy headers.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Give the legacy-header test a complete v0 report — For `REPORT v1\nversion=v0`, this test passes because the fixture lacks `END`, so parsing returns before checking the header. The replacement changes the body’s version and leaves the header at v1. — This test cannot detect the legacy-header defect it claims to guard. — Fix: Use `REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND`, or consolidate this test with the existing complete-report rejection test.
